Notice of Interim Results and Investor Presentation
Living REIT plc will announce its interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 on Thursday 24 September 2026.
An in-person presentation for analysts will be hosted by LIVE's Investment Manager at 08.30 on the day of results. Those wishing to attend should contact Lauder Teacher on the details below.
A webinar for institutional investors will be held later the same day, at 15.00. Those wishing to attend the webinar should contact Atrato Partners on the details below.
The Company's Interim Results and accompanying presentation will be available via our website at www.livingreit.com.
Investor Presentation via Investor Meet Company
Michael Carey and Natalie Markham from LIVE's Investment Manager will also present the interim results via the Investor Meet Company platform on Friday 25 September 2026 at 10.00.

The presentation is open to all existing and potential shareholders. Questions can be submitted prior to the meeting through the Investor Meet Company dashboard up until 16.00 the day before the meeting, or at any time during the presentation.
Those wishing to attend can sign up via the Investor Meet Company platform here: https://www.investormeetcompany.com/living-reit-plc/register-investor
Investors who already follow Living REIT plc on the Investor Meet Company platform will automatically be invited.
Living REIT is a UK-listed real estate investment trust that aims to provide shareholders with stable, long-term, inflation-aligned income through investment in a portfolio of Living assets.

The Company invests in structurally supported areas of the UK residential property market, with a focus on delivering resilient income and positive social impact. This includes investments in specialised supported housing, senior living and care homes.
Living REIT's properties provide essential social infrastructure, supporting residents and communities whilst seeking to generate an attractive, inflation-aligned total return for shareholders.
All capitalised terms not otherwise defined in the text of this announcement have the meanings given to them in the announcement dated 17 June 2026.
The Company is listed on the closed-ended investment funds category of the FCA's Official List and its Ordinary Shares are traded on the LSE's Main Market.
Atrato Partners Limited is the Company's Investment Manager.
Further information on the Company can be found on its website at www.livingreit.com.
